content.name: Shining Smite

time.condition: which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|SRD52}

entries: The target hit by the strike takes an extra {@damage 2d6} Radiant damage from the attack. Until the spell ends, the target sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 5-foot radius, attack rolls against it have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52}, and it can't benefit from the {@condition Invisible|SRD52} condition.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.
